meta: In a class where everyone goes at the same speed, fast learners get bored and slow learners fall behind. Adaptive learning means the machine learns how you learn. Here's how to turn AI into your own tutor.
prompt: Be my tutor for ____. Ask me one question at a time. If I get it right, make the next one harder. If I get it wrong, explain briefly and ask an easier one. After 10 questions, tell me which parts I'm weak at.

muc.title: Same lesson, same speed
muc.text: The whole class learns the same lesson at the same speed. Fast learners get bored, and slower learners fall behind.

muc.title: What is adaptive learning?
muc.text: Adaptive learning is when a machine learns how you learn. It's like everyone having a private tutor who teaches exactly where you are.

muc.title: A 4-step loop
muc.text: The secret is a loop. The system asks you a question and watches whether you answer right or wrong, fast or slow. Then it guesses your level and picks the next question to match.

muc.title: Right means harder, wrong means step back
muc.text: Get it right, and the questions get harder. Get it wrong, and it goes back to the basics you're missing. Words you tend to forget come back just before you would forget them.

muc.title: You're already using it
muc.text: Most of the language apps, test-prep apps and vocabulary apps you use run on this loop.

muc.title: Do it yourself with an AI chat
muc.text: You don't need a special app. You can turn an AI chat into an adaptive tutor with one message.

muc.title: Turn AI into your tutor
muc.text: Tell AI: be my tutor for a topic. Ask me one question at a time. If I'm right, make it harder. If I'm wrong, explain and ask an easier one. After ten questions, tell me what I'm weak at.
